title.zh: 自然灾害：地震、台风与沙尘暴

clips.send: Beichuan. Today: Beichuan Qiang Autonomous County, Mianyang, Sichuan. The old town was wrecked by the earthquake and landslides. It is kept as a memorial, and a new Beichuan was built on safer ground nearby.
clips.text: Beichuan. Today: Beichuan Qiang Autonomous County, Mianyang, Sichuan. The old town was wrecked by the earthquake and landslides. It is kept as a memorial, and a new Beichuan was built on safer ground nearby.

clips.send: South China Sea Islands. The Dongsha, Xisha, Zhongsha and Nansha islands — mostly small coral islands, reefs and banks.
clips.text: South China Sea Islands. The Dongsha, Xisha, Zhongsha and Nansha islands — mostly small coral islands, reefs and banks.

clips.send: Indian Ocean. The third-largest ocean. Zheng He’s fleets sailed across it to India, Arabia and East Africa, riding the monsoon winds.
clips.text: Indian Ocean. The third-largest ocean. Zheng He’s fleets sailed across it to India, Arabia and East Africa, riding the monsoon winds.

clips.send: Beijing. China’s capital and its political and cultural centre. The Forbidden City, the palace of the Ming and Qing emperors, is in the middle of the city.
clips.text: Beijing. China’s capital and its political and cultural centre. The Forbidden City, the palace of the Ming and Qing emperors, is in the middle of the city.

clips.send: Pacific Ocean. The biggest and deepest ocean. In summer, warm wet winds blow from it onto eastern China and bring the rainy season.
clips.text: Pacific Ocean. The biggest and deepest ocean. In summer, warm wet winds blow from it onto eastern China and bring the rainy season.

clips.send: Three-North Shelter Forest. Today: Northwest, North and Northeast China. The “Great Green Wall”: belts of trees planted across northern China since 1978 to hold back wind and sand.
clips.text: Three-North Shelter Forest. Today: Northwest, North and Northeast China. The “Great Green Wall”: belts of trees planted across northern China since 1978 to hold back wind and sand.

clips.send: Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. The highest plateau on Earth, on average over 4,000 m. The Yangtze, Yellow and Lancang (Mekong) rivers all start here.
clips.text: Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. The highest plateau on Earth, on average over 4,000 m. The Yangtze, Yellow and Lancang (Mekong) rivers all start here.

clips.send: Sichuan Basin. Ringed by mountains, the basin has purple soil, mild winters and lots of cloud. The Chengdu Plain inside it is one of China’s richest farm areas.
clips.text: Sichuan Basin. Ringed by mountains, the basin has purple soil, mild winters and lots of cloud. The Chengdu Plain inside it is one of China’s richest farm areas.

clips.send: Heilongjiang.
clips.text: Heilongjiang.

clips.send: Taiwan. Taiwan has been part of China since ancient times. Two-thirds of the island is mountains; the Tropic of Cancer crosses its middle.
clips.text: Taiwan. Taiwan has been part of China since ancient times. Two-thirds of the island is mountains; the Tropic of Cancer crosses its middle.

clips.send: Hainan Island. China’s second-largest island, warm all year round. It became a province and the biggest Special Economic Zone in 1988.
clips.text: Hainan Island. China’s second-largest island, warm all year round. It became a province and the biggest Special Economic Zone in 1988.

clips.send: Wenchuan. Today: Wenchuan County, Aba, Sichuan. The most destructive earthquake since 1949. Rescuers came from all over China, and every province helped rebuild a stricken county with stronger schools and homes.
clips.text: Wenchuan. Today: Wenchuan County, Aba, Sichuan. The most destructive earthquake since 1949. Rescuers came from all over China, and every province helped rebuild a stricken county with stronger schools and homes.

clips.send: Pearl River Delta. Where the Pearl River reaches the sea, cities like Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao form one of the world’s biggest city clusters — the Greater Bay Area.
clips.text: Pearl River Delta. Where the Pearl River reaches the sea, cities like Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao form one of the world’s biggest city clusters — the Greater Bay Area.

clips.send: Inner Mongolia.
clips.text: Inner Mongolia.

clips.send: Longmen Shan. Today: Western edge of the Sichuan Basin. Where the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau pushes east against the Sichuan Basin. The rocks along this fault snapped in 2008 and caused the Wenchuan earthquake.
clips.text: Longmen Shan. Today: Western edge of the Sichuan Basin. Where the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau pushes east against the Sichuan Basin. The rocks along this fault snapped in 2008 and caused the Wenchuan earthquake.

clips.send: 太平洋。世界上最大、最深的大洋。夏季，来自太平洋的暖湿气流吹向我国东部，带来雨季。
clips.text: 太平洋。世界上最大、最深的大洋。夏季，来自太平洋的暖湿气流吹向我国东部，带来雨季。

clips.send: 香港。鸦片战争后，香港被英国占领。1997年中国恢复对香港行使主权，实行“一国两制”。
clips.text: 香港。鸦片战争后，香港被英国占领。1997年中国恢复对香港行使主权，实行“一国两制”。

clips.send: 龙门山。今天：四川盆地西缘。青藏高原向东推挤四川盆地的地方。2008年，这里的断裂带岩层突然错动，引发了汶川地震。
clips.text: 龙门山。今天：四川盆地西缘。青藏高原向东推挤四川盆地的地方。2008年，这里的断裂带岩层突然错动，引发了汶川地震。

clips.send: 印度洋。世界第三大洋。郑和的船队借助季风横渡印度洋，到达印度、阿拉伯半岛和非洲东海岸。
clips.text: 印度洋。世界第三大洋。郑和的船队借助季风横渡印度洋，到达印度、阿拉伯半岛和非洲东海岸。

clips.send: 珠江三角洲。珠江入海处，广州、深圳、香港、澳门等城市连成一片，形成世界级城市群——粤港澳大湾区。

clips.send: 汶川。今天：四川阿坝汶川县。新中国成立以来破坏性最强的地震。全国各地赶来救援，各省市“对口支援”，按更高的抗震标准重建学校和住房。

clips.send: 长城。秦始皇把秦、赵、燕的长城连接起来，西起临洮、东到辽东。图钉标在北京附近的八达岭，这是最著名的一段。

clips.send: 上海。上海位于长江入海口，上海港的集装箱吞吐量居世界第一。
clips.text: 上海。上海位于长江入海口，上海港的集装箱吞吐量居世界第一。

clips.send: 台湾。台湾自古以来就是中国的领土。岛上三分之二是山地，北回归线从中部穿过。
clips.text: 台湾。台湾自古以来就是中国的领土。岛上三分之二是山地，北回归线从中部穿过。

clips.send: 海南岛。海南岛是我国第二大岛，终年温暖。1988年建省并成为全国最大的经济特区。
clips.text: 海南岛。海南岛是我国第二大岛，终年温暖。1988年建省并成为全国最大的经济特区。

clips.send: 澳门。澳门曾长期被葡萄牙占领，1999年回归祖国。澳门历史城区是世界文化遗产。
clips.text: 澳门。澳门曾长期被葡萄牙占领，1999年回归祖国。澳门历史城区是世界文化遗产。

clips.send: 四川盆地。四川盆地四周群山环绕，紫色土广布，冬季温和、多云雾。盆地西部的成都平原物产丰富。
clips.text: 四川盆地。四川盆地四周群山环绕，紫色土广布，冬季温和、多云雾。盆地西部的成都平原物产丰富。

clips.send: 北川。今天：四川绵阳北川羌族自治县。老县城在地震和山体滑坡中严重损毁，作为遗址保留下来；新北川县城在更安全的地方重建。

clips.send: 南海诸岛。包括东沙、西沙、中沙、南沙四大群岛，多为珊瑚岛、礁和暗沙。
